verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a public REST API for reading and changing account configuration, including users, workflows, on-call and incidents. It also has an Events API for triggering, acknowledging and resolving alerts, versioned requests, OpenAPI schemas in a public repo, and an interactive API reference with a try-it console. One community report describes confusing v1/v2 Events API key handling, which is friction rather than a contradiction of the documented API. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that the API reliably covers the full product surface, and clearer key/version handling for the Events API.
